name: Underlying Attributes 4
definition: Provides additional details on the underlying. In securities financing deals, it is used to identify and provide information on the collateral.

AllocationPercentage.name: Allocation Percentage
AllocationPercentage.definition: Percent of the strike price that this underlying represents.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Unit amount of the underlying security.

SettlementType.name: Settlement Type
SettlementType.definition: Indicates order settlement period for the underlying instrument. Represents the number of days until settlement; for example, 2 means T+1 settlement, 4 means T+3 settlement, 5 means T+4 settlement.

CashAmount.name: Cash Amount
CashAmount.definition: Cash amount associated with the underlying component. Necessary for derivatives that deliver into more than one underlying instrument and one of the underlying's is a fixed cash value.

CashType.name: Cash Type
CashType.definition: Represents how the cash will be calculated. Indicates that the cash is either fixed or a difference value (difference between strike and current underlying price).

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: In a financing deal, clean price (percent-of-par or per unit) of the underlying security or basket.

DirtyPrice.name: Dirty Price
DirtyPrice.definition: In a financing deal, price (percent-of-par or per unit) of the underlying security or basket. "Dirty" means it includes accrued interest.

EndPrice.name: End Price
EndPrice.definition: In a financing deal, price (percent-of-par or per unit) of the underlying security or basket at the end of the agreement.

StartValue.name: Start Value
StartValue.definition: Currency value attributed to this collateral at the start of the agreement.

CurrentValue.name: Current Value
CurrentValue.definition: Currency value currently attributed to this collateral.

EndValue.name: End Value
EndValue.definition: Currency value attributed to this collateral at the end of the agreement.

AdjustedQuantity.name: Adjusted Quantity
AdjustedQuantity.definition: Unit amount of the underlying security (shares) adjusted for pending corporate action not yet allocated.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Foreign exchange rate used to compute the current value.

CapValue.name: Cap Value
CapValue.definition: Maximum notional value for a financial instrument that is capped.
